parallel_execution_contract.partition: canonical template_id,column_id order with deterministic static round-robin worker assignment
parallel_execution_contract.worker_ownership: one reusable backend/solver/workspace per worker; never one heavy solver per column
parallel_execution_contract.state_access: each worker may mutate only state_registry(state_handle) values uniquely claimed by its assigned columns
parallel_execution_contract.collection: results and diagnostics stored by logical input index and reduced after join in canonical order
parallel_execution_contract.transaction_semantics: unchanged checkpoint -> trial -> candidate -> commit/rollback per column
parallel_execution_contract.mass_semantics: unchanged hard per-column and authoritative aggregate mass accounting

required_implementation_refactor: Expose the already existing serialized per-column execute seam rather than duplicate transaction logic.
Use a shared atomic active-physical-solve counter only for concurrency diagnostics; it may not influence solver decisions.
Allocate one fmr_serialized_reference_backend_t and one kernel executor/control context per worker.
Keep worker_count=1 delegated to the qualified serialized path.
Reject multiworker requests outside the exact v1 physical/provider profile before any physical solve.
required_qualification: exact committed physical state, lineage, revision and committed-time identity
exact per-column and authoritative aggregate mass identity
max_simultaneous_real_physical_solves >= 2 for a dedicated overlap fixture
not_admitted: bottom mode -2 parallel execution until separately replayed
